info.title: Rabt AI Engine
info.summary: Local LLM agent, speech-to-text and text-to-speech for Rabt.
info.description: Contract: docs/API_CONTRACT.md (version 0.1.1). All inference runs locally. The engine proposes actions; the integration backend executes them.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Unique per user turn. Re-sending the same body replays the stored response.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Chosen by the backend; bound to account_id on first use.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: Authenticated by the integration backend. Never derived from message text.

sent_at.title: Sent At
sent_at.description: When the user sent the message. Defaults to the time the engine received it.

AgentRespondRequest.title: AgentRespondRequest
AgentRespondRequest.description: One user turn, sent by the authenticated integration backend.

pending_proposal_ids.title: Pending Proposal Ids
pending_proposal_ids.description: Every unresolved proposal of this turn.

cancelled_proposal_ids.title: Cancelled Proposal Ids
cancelled_proposal_ids.description: Proposals withdrawn by the engine. Do not execute them; withdraw approval prompts.

model.title: Model
model.description: Local model that produced the reply.

file.title: File
file.description: Audio: wav, mp3, ogg/opus, webm, m4a, flac

CreateDraftArgs.title: CreateDraftArgs
CreateDraftArgs.description: Create (not send) an email draft in the requester's own mailbox.

CreateEventArgs.title: CreateEventArgs
CreateEventArgs.description: Create a calendar event organized by the requester and invite attendees.

daily_start.title: Daily Start
daily_start.description: Optional (0.1.1): on every day of the window, only consider times from this local time (HH:MM in `timezone`). Used for searches like 'any evening this week'.

daily_end.title: Daily End
daily_end.description: Optional (0.1.1): on every day of the window, only consider times until this local time.

FindMutualSlotArgs.title: FindMutualSlotArgs
FindMutualSlotArgs.description: Find windows where every participant is free, using authorized free/busy data only.

FindMutualSlotResult.title: FindMutualSlotResult
FindMutualSlotResult.description: Free windows only. Never include event titles, attendees or other private details.
